subject: Renewal kickoff — staffing, term change options, and QBR booking
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Levin <morgan@blueharbor.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal kickoff — staffing, term change options, and QBR booking

Hi Morgan / Priya —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our roadmap, BlueHarbor’s renewal window is approaching and we want to kick off a short renewal + expansion planning thread so we can lock staffing, term options, and a QBR slot. High-level items I suggest we cover in the kickoff: 

- Current usage and projected monthly token/throughput for next 12 months
- Term/commit options (12 v 24 months) and trial uplift for search/embeddings
- Capacity staging: baseline, burst buffer, and optional dedicated pool
- Legal/finance milestones and expected DocuSign timeline
- QBR timing — exec readout + ops deep-dive (30–60 mins)

Proposed next steps: 
1) Can you confirm your procurement lead and any legal constraints (Priya, is this the right person?)
2) Please pick 2 QBR windows next week (we have Tue 11/3 10–12 PT or Thu 11/5 2–4 PT as options)
3) I’ll loop in Kimberly (SRE onboarding) and Marissa (Customer Success) for staffing and rollout plan

Attaching an initial mutual action checklist and a draft SOW to make the conversation concrete.

Attachments: BlueHarbor_MCP_v2.pdf (attachment), SOW_BH_v0.5.docx (attachment)

Thanks — look forward to aligning.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Morgan Levin <morgan@blueharbor.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@blueharbor.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — staffing, term change options, and QBR booking

Ben —

Thanks for getting this started. Priya is our procurement lead and copied here; she will own contract cadence / approvals. A couple quick notes from our side: 

- We are targeting a 24-month term but would like a flexible burst allowance for Q4 traffic spikes.
- Current baseline throughput is ~2.2B tokens/mo with expected 25% growth (pilot + new ML features).
- For the QBR, we prefer Thu 11/5 2–3 PT (that works best for our execs).

Priya — our target procurement timeline is to finalize economics and legal redlines by 11/19 so we can exec no later than 11/30. Can you confirm if that’s realistic on your end?

Longer reply to technical staffing from Kimberly would be great; Kim, feel free to suggest a short ops-runbook we can review during the QBR.

Forwarded message: BlueHarbor internal forecast attached (BlueHarbor_usage_nov.pdf).

Morgan Levin
Head of ML Platforms | BlueHarbor Inc.
morgan@blueharbor.com

Forwarding with a few internal asks —

Kimberly / Marissa — Morgan confirmed Thu 11/5 2–3 PT for the QBR and indicated preference for a 24-month term with burst buffer. Can you: 

- Kimberly: propose 2 staffing options for the pilot -> steady-state (names/roles + approximate FTEs), and confirm whether a dedicated pool for burst is feasible within the proposed timeline.
- Marissa: draft a 30–45 minute QBR agenda (exec readout + ops playbook + contract milestones).
- I’ll consolidate and send a single-plan slide before Thu so the customer has a crisp readout.

Also FYI, procurement asks for a single-set of redlines to speed legal review — see the attached suggested redlines (redlines_SOW_v0.5.pdf).

Thanks — Ben

Ben / team —

Confirmed: Thu 11/5 2:00–3:00 PT is reserved. Draft QBR agenda (short):

1) Exec readout (10 min) — Morgan
2) Usage & growth forecast (5 min) — Ben
3) Ops & staffing plan (10 min) — Kimberly
4) Term options & procurement milestones (5 min) — Ben/Priya
5) Q&A + next steps (15 min)

Staffing options (brief):
- Option A (lean): 0.4 FTE SRE + 0.25 CS engineer — faster ramp, relies on shared GP-managed pool.
- Option B (dedicated): 1.0 FTE SRE + 0.5 CS engineer + dedicated burst pool (recommended if spikes >2.5x baseline).

Notes: Option B requires procurement signoff for a short-lived dedicated pool (we can stage it as a 3-month burst add-on). I’ve attached a one-pager runbook and the SOW redlines for your legal team.
